result:
`bun run typecheck` is clean and `bun test` passes (8 tests across 3 files, including the 6 new ones).

I made the excerpt optional end to end. In `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` the `excerpt` field lost its `min(1, 'Excerpt is required.')` and gained `.default('')`, so a missing, empty, or whitespace-only excerpt now parses to `''` while title and body keep their blank checks (422 unchanged). A new dependency-free helper `app/Support/excerpt.ts` exports `deriveExcerpt(body)`, implementing the rule exactly: trim, return the body whole at ≤140 characters, otherwise keep the first 140 but back up to the last whitespace when characters 140 and 141 are both non-whitespace (cutting at 140 when the opening has no whitespace at all), then trim trailing whitespace and append a single `…` — both worked examples reproduce byte for byte at 139 and 141 characters. `PostController` routes both `store` and `update` through a private `withExcerpt(data)` that falls back to the derived value whenever the submitted excerpt is blank, so an update with an empty excerpt re-derives from the new body and a provided excerpt always wins. The two forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx`, `Edit.tsx`) now label the field "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback and tolerate an undefined value; `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` was regenerated via `bun run codegen`, making `excerpt?: string` in the `posts.store`/`posts.update` body types. New unit tests live in `tests/excerpt.test.ts`.
